design.decision: Bid on a hand with no junk: [8]s and [9]s become [J]s and [Q]s, and [2]-[7]s become [5]-[10]s that win late tricks but still count as [2] through [10]; nil now needs a much weaker hand.
design.opponent: Shows as unusually high bids and mid cards that keep winning; opponents can't lead low to make the team waste honors.
design.rationale: Source-filtered upgrades measure well, and seed-raise is the strongest measured enabler (+11). This one targets the other end of the hand: seed-raise mostly turns honors into [A]s, while this turns junk into mid cards and leaves the honors alone, so the two stack instead of duplicating.
design.draftText: Opening: Raise every [2] through [9] your team holds by three ranks

critic.concerns: Near-duplicate of rb-low-raise (range only); raising [2]-[9] works against several Low Cards payoffs whose ranges it moves cards out of, so the LowCards tag is doubtful.
